research_question: Across the unchanged 601-pair natural-session windows, does high compensated response align more consistently with track-supported periodic pose/flow structure or with temporally clustered blur, low-feature support, and forward-backward failure?
estimand: Per-session descriptive mechanism-routing pattern; capture_session is the independent descriptive unit and adjacent_frame_pair is a repeated longitudinal measurement.
forbidden_claims: recall, precision, AUROC, F1 or safety benefit

forbidden: risk, obstacle or manual gait label access

stage_1.name: RESPONSE_BLIND_DIRECTION_AND_SIGNED_POSE_EXTRACTION
stage_1.output: one hash-bound direction ledger per session

stage_2.name: FROZEN_TEMPORAL_JOIN_AND_DESCRIPTION
forbidden_actions: change bands, thresholds or terminal rules

pose.signed_camera_angular_velocity: Rodrigues rotation vector of current_from_previous in the R3 camera basis, divided by dt, xyz degrees/s
pose.signed_camera_translation_velocity: world position delta expressed in the current camera basis and R3 camera basis, divided by dt, xyz m/s

flow.tracker: same Shi-Tomasi plus pyramidal LK forward/backward settings as R0

high_response.definition: within-session top 20 percent by deterministic average rank of absolute unchanged compensated response among R3-evaluable pairs
high_response.meaning: descriptive response stratum, not error or risk truth

pose_periodicity.selected_component: response-blind component with maximum band-energy fraction

pose_cycles.construction: positive-going zero crossings of the selected component after ideal FFT band-pass reconstruction at 0.7-3.0 Hz
pose_cycles.cycle_response_phase: phase of the maximum absolute evaluable response within each valid complete cycle
reported: fraction of cycles containing high response
cycle-max absolute-response axial phase-locking value |mean(exp(2i phase))|

flow_temporal_direction.pair_axis: first principal component of response-blind evaluable [median dx, median dy, median radial flow] vectors; deterministic positive-x, then positive-y, then positive-radial sign
flow_temporal_direction.adjacent_direction_consistency: median cosine similarity for consecutive direction-evaluable pair vectors
flow_temporal_direction.pose_frequency_periodicity: R-squared of intercept plus sine/cosine regression of flow-axis projection at the selected pose dominant frequency

measurement_failure.blur_pair: within-session bottom 20 percent by deterministic average rank of R0 sharpness_laplacian_variance
measurement_failure.low_texture_pair: within-session bottom 20 percent by deterministic average rank of R0 detected_features_per_valid_megapixel
measurement_failure.failure_pair: feature collapse or round-trip failure or blur pair
measurement_failure.event: one or more consecutive failure pairs
reported: high-response prevalence ratio in failure versus non-failure pairs

track_consistent_periodic_motion_support: flow periodic R-squared at pose dominant frequency >= 0.20
at least 50 percent of valid cycles contain high response
at least 3 consecutive valid cycles contain high response
at least 70 percent of high-response pairs are direction-evaluable
measurement_failure_support_requires_all: at least 50 percent of high-response pairs are failure pairs
high-response prevalence ratio in failure versus non-failure pairs >= 1.50
at least one failure event spans 3 consecutive pairs

cross_session_terminal.PRIORITIZE_MOTION_DECOMPOSITION_OR_TEMPO: track-consistent periodic-motion support in at least 3 of 4 sessions and measurement-failure support in at most 1 of 4
cross_session_terminal.PRIORITIZE_QUALITY_GATE_REDESIGN: measurement-failure support in at least 3 of 4 sessions and track-consistent periodic-motion support in at most 1 of 4
cross_session_terminal.NOT_EVALUABLE: fewer than 3 sessions have valid input identity, at least 4 valid cycles, and at least 70 percent direction-evaluable pairs

interpretation_rule: A motion-priority terminal only supports investigating self-motion decomposition or temporal modeling; a quality-priority terminal only supports investigating a redesigned quality gate. Neither terminal identifies false alerts, normal gait, risk truth or causality.
required_artifacts: independent validator that does not import the production summarizer
